name: CURL.Cleanup
summary: Releases an open request handle.
details: Takes the handle returned by CURL.New. It is an alias of CURL.Release.

name: CURL.GetDebugAsText
summary: Requests the debug transcript for a request handle.
details: The function is accepted, but transcript formatting is unavailable and the call returns an MBS error.
differences: The engine reports that the debug transcript format is unavailable.

name: CURL.GetDebugMessages
summary: Requests debug messages for a request handle.
details: The function is accepted, but transcript formatting is unavailable and the call returns an MBS error.
differences: The engine reports that the debug transcript format is unavailable.

name: CURL.GetHeaderAsText
summary: Reads response headers as text from a completed request.
details: The handle must contain a response. Encoding accepts UTF-8 or native; line endings are normalized unless the preserve flag is nonzero.
differences: Only UTF-8 and native encodings are accepted; line endings are normalized by default.

name: CURL.GetResponseCode
summary: Returns the HTTP status code stored on a request handle.
details: Returns zero before a response has been stored.

name: CURL.GetResultAsText
summary: Reads the response body as text from a completed request.
details: The handle must contain a response. Encoding accepts UTF-8 or native; line endings are normalized unless the preserve flag is nonzero.
differences: Only UTF-8 and native encodings are accepted; line endings are normalized by default.

name: CURL.New
summary: Creates a request handle for configuring an HTTP request.
details: Handles belong to the script session and are limited to 16 open handles; release them when finished.

name: CURL.Perform
summary: Performs the configured request through the guarded script network bridge.
details: Needs a configured HTTP or HTTPS URL and network access enabled for the script. The server refuses outbound requests by default. The result is a cURL-style status number; a completed response is retained on the handle.
differences: Outbound access is guarded and disabled by default; redirects and response handling follow the server network guard.

name: CURL.Release
summary: Releases an open request handle.
details: Takes the handle returned by CURL.New.

name: CURL.SetDebugWithData
summary: Sets whether debug output may include data on a request handle.
details: The flag is stored on the handle; debug transcript retrieval is unavailable.
differences: The flag is accepted, but debug transcript retrieval returns an MBS error.

name: CURL.SetInputText
summary: Sets text to use as an upload request body.
details: Upload mode must be enabled before performing an upload. Encoding accepts UTF-8 or native.
differences: Only UTF-8 and native encodings are accepted.

name: CURL.SetOptionCustomRequest
summary: Sets the HTTP method for a request handle.
details: The method must contain letters only and is uppercased. Encoding accepts UTF-8 or native.
differences: Only alphabetic method names and UTF-8 or native encodings are accepted.

name: CURL.SetOptionFollowLocation
summary: Enables or disables redirect following for a request.
details: Accepts integer 0 or 1; other cURL follow flags are rejected.
differences: Only values 0 and 1 are supported.

name: CURL.SetOptionHTTPHeader
summary: Replaces the request headers with the supplied header lines.
details: Each header must contain a colon after a nonempty name and must not contain line endings.
differences: Headers are supplied as separate arguments and line breaks within a header are rejected.

name: CURL.SetOptionMaxRedirs
summary: Sets the redirect limit for a request handle.
details: Accepts -1 or a nonnegative integer.

name: CURL.SetOptionPassword
summary: Sets the password used with the request username.
details: Credentials are applied as HTTP Basic authorization except when AWS signing is configured. Encoding accepts UTF-8 or native.
differences: Only UTF-8 and native encodings are accepted.

name: CURL.SetOptionPostFields
summary: Sets the request body as POST fields.
details: When no content type is supplied, the engine uses application/x-www-form-urlencoded. Encoding accepts UTF-8 or native.
differences: Only UTF-8 and native encodings are accepted.

name: CURL.SetOptionSSLVerifyHost
summary: Requires full host verification for TLS requests.
details: Only value 2 is accepted; the option cannot disable verification.
differences: Only value 2 is accepted to require full TLS verification.

name: CURL.SetOptionSSLVerifyPeer
summary: Requires peer certificate verification for TLS requests.
details: Only value 1 is accepted; the option cannot disable verification.
differences: Only value 1 is accepted; disabling certificate verification is refused.

name: CURL.SetOptionSSLVersion
summary: Accepts the default TLS version setting for a request.
details: Only value 0 is accepted; explicit version selection is unavailable.
differences: Only value 0 is accepted.

name: CURL.SetOptionUpload
summary: Enables or disables upload mode for a request.
details: Upload mode uses text set with CURL.SetInputText and defaults to PUT unless a custom method is set.

name: CURL.SetOptionURL
summary: Sets the destination URL for a request handle.
details: CURL.Perform supports HTTP and HTTPS URLs. Encoding accepts UTF-8 or native.
differences: Only HTTP and HTTPS are performed; other schemes return an unsupported-protocol status.

name: CURL.SetOptionUsername
summary: Sets the username used for HTTP Basic authorization.
details: Credentials are not applied as Basic authorization when AWS signing is configured. Encoding accepts UTF-8 or native.
differences: Only UTF-8 and native encodings are accepted.

name: CURL.SetOptionUseSSL
summary: Accepts the default setting that avoids FTP TLS transfer mode.
details: Only value 0 is accepted; nonzero values request an unsupported FTP transfer.
differences: Only value 0 is accepted; FTP transfers are unavailable.

name: CURL.SetOptionVerbose
summary: Sets the verbose flag on a request handle.
details: The flag is accepted; debug transcript retrieval is unavailable.
differences: The flag is stored, but debug transcript retrieval returns an MBS error.

name: CURL.SetupAWS
signature: CURL.SetupAWS ( handle ; accessKey ; secret ; region ; service ; path ; domain ; verb ; hashedPayload ; headers ; query )
summary: Configures AWS request signing and the request URL.
details: Needs access key, secret, region, service, an absolute path and a supported HTTP verb. Domain may be empty to use the service and region host. Optional hashed payload, extra headers and query parameters are rejected.
differences: Hashed payload, extra headers and query parameters are unavailable; file uploads with AWS signing are also rejected.

name: CURL.SetUpdateProgressDialog
summary: Accepts the progress-dialog update option.
details: This client-oriented helper is accepted and returns OK without displaying or updating a dialog.
differences: The function is accepted but ignored; it returns OK without a dialog.
